content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Hemoglobin inclusion criterion appears to have a typo (≥18 g/dL) and is inconsistent with the note",
      "quote": "Hemoglobin Hemoglobin ≥ 18 g/dL. NOTE: Patients requiring ongoing transfusions or growth factor support to maintain hemoglobin ≥9 g/dL are not eligible.",
      "page": 43,
      "section": "5.1 Inclusion Criteria",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The required hemoglobin level is stated as ≥18 g/dL, which is abnormally high and likely a typo (should be ≥9 g/dL). The note references maintaining hemoglobin ≥9 g/dL, creating an internal inconsistency that would make the criterion impossible to meet for most patients and likely lead to amendments.",
      "fix": "Correct the hemoglobin threshold to ≥9 g/dL (or the intended value) and ensure consistency with the note."
    },
    {
      "title": "Exclusion of HER2 mutant NSCLC may conflict with the basket trial objective",
      "quote": "2 HER2 mutant NSCLC.",
      "page": 47,
      "section": "5.2 Exclusion Criteria",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The primary objective is to assess T-DXd in patients with HER2 activating mutations across tumor types, but excluding HER2 mutant NSCLC removes a major tumor type with known HER2 mutations, potentially limiting the generalizability and contradicting the 'across tumor types' intent.",
      "fix": "Clarify the rationale for excluding HER2 mutant NSCLC or include it if the objective is truly pan-tumor."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inclusion criterion for tumor sample timing is ambiguous and may be restrictive",
      "quote": "The sample should be obtained at the time of diagnosis of metastatic or locally advanced unresectable disease. If not available, a pre-enrolment sample obtained upon diagnosis of metastatic or locally advanced unresectable disease will be accepted.",
      "page": 43,
      "section": "5.1 Inclusion Criteria",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The requirement for a tumor sample at diagnosis of metastatic disease may be difficult to meet in practice, and the distinction between 'at the time of diagnosis' and 'pre-enrolment' is unclear, potentially causing delays or exclusions.",
      "fix": "Allow any archival tumor sample from any time point if recent sample is unavailable, and clarify the acceptable time window."
    },
    {
      "title": "ECG monitoring for QTc prolongation is not specified in the safety assessments",
      "quote": "Corrected QT interval by Fridericia's formula (QTcF) prolongation to > 470 msec (females) or > 450 msec (males) based on average of the screening triplicate 12-lead ECG.",
      "page": 47,
      "section": "5.2 Exclusion Criteria",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol excludes patients with QTc prolongation but does not describe ongoing ECG monitoring during the study, which is important for a drug with potential cardiac effects (T-DXd has boxed warnings for cardiac toxicity).",
      "fix": "Add scheduled ECGs in the Schedule of Activities and specify frequency of QTc monitoring during treatment."
    },
    {
      "title": "No explicit stopping rules or dose modification criteria for ILD are provided",
      "quote": "Has a history of (non-infectious) interstitial lung disease (ILD)/pneumonitis that required steroids, has current ILD/pneumonitis, or where suspected ILD/pneumonitis cannot be ruled out by imaging at screening.",
      "page": 47,
      "section": "5.2 Exclusion Criteria",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "ILD is a known serious adverse event for T-DXd, but the protocol lacks specific guidance on how to monitor for ILD during the study (e.g., imaging frequency) and what dose modifications or discontinuation rules apply if ILD occurs.",
      "fix": "Include ILD monitoring plan (e.g., chest imaging at regular intervals) and management guidelines for ILD."
    },
    {
      "title": "Creatinine clearance threshold may be too low for a drug with renal excretion",
      "quote": "Creatinine clearance ≥ 30 mL/min (as calculated using the Cockcroft and Gault equation)",
      "page": 43,
      "section": "5.1 Inclusion Criteria",
      "category": "advisory",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "A creatinine clearance of ≥30 mL/min is permissive, but T-DXd is an antibody-drug conjugate with a payload that may have renal clearance; consider whether a higher threshold is needed to ensure safety.",
      "fix": "Review pharmacokinetic data to confirm the appropriate renal function threshold."
    },
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint ORR by ICR may be inconsistent with investigator-assessed measurable disease",
      "quote": "Has measurable target disease assessed by the Investigator based on RECIST v1.1.",
      "page": 43,
      "section": "5.1 Inclusion Criteria",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Eligibility uses investigator assessment of measurable disease, but the primary endpoint is confirmed ORR by ICR. Discrepancies between investigator and ICR assessments could lead to patients being enrolled who do not have measurable disease by ICR, affecting endpoint evaluation.",
      "fix": "Consider requiring measurable disease by both investigator and ICR, or at least central review of baseline scans."
    },
    {
      "title": "Exclusion of patients with pleural effusion requiring drainage may be overly restrictive",
      "quote": "Has a pleural effusion, ascites or pericardial effusion that requires drainage, peritoneal shunt, or Cell-free and Concentrated Ascites Reinfusion Therapy (CART).",
      "page": 47,
      "section": "5.2 Exclusion Criteria",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "This exclusion is broad and may exclude patients with manageable effusions that are not related to drug safety, potentially limiting enrollment in a basket trial where such symptoms are common in advanced cancer.",
      "fix": "Clarify that only uncontrolled or symptomatic effusions requiring intervention within a certain timeframe are excluded."
    }
  ]
}
